# Expense Tracker

## About the Project

Expense Tracker is a Python-based mini project designed to record expenses and generate monthly expense reports.

## Features

- Add expense details
- Store expense description, category, and amount
- Generate monthly expense reports
- Display expense reference IDs

## Technologies Used

- Python
- Python Functions
- Lists and Dictionaries

## Project Structure

```text
module_05_expense_tracker/
├── main.py
├── expense_utils.py
├── report_utils.py
├── requirement.txt
└── README.md
```

## How to Run

```bash
python main.py
```
